item.title: YouTube Music — via awesome-mac
item.description: Desktop player for YouTube Music with plugin support.

item.title: WhatsApp Desktop — via awesome-mac
item.description: Available in the Mac App Store, Whatsapp for Desktop.

item.description: Open-source blue team tool that runs Sigma detection rules on the macOS unified log, Windows event logs and Linux auth.log, live or on collected files, and writes a report mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

item.title: Usagebar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free native macOS menu bar app that shows Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, z.ai and DeepSeek usage limits, plus when they reset.

item.title: Textual — via awesome-mac
item.description: Internet Relay Chat (IRC) client.

item.title: Takeline — via awesome-mac
item.description: Fork of Textream that follows your voice in French and English entirely on the Mac, with retake detection and voice commands.

item.title: SwiftBiu — via awesome-mac
item.description: Text productivity tool with a customizable action bar and AI extensions.

item.title: SummonOS — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app and CLI that gives coding agents live Mac context over MCP and snapshots supported settings changes so they can be undone.

item.description: Free menu-bar app that runs your local dev servers. Claude Code and Codex can start, stop and read logs through its MCP server and local API, with your approval.

item.description: Turns a folder of talking-head footage into a rough cut in Final Cut Pro, with on-device Whisper transcription and cuts chosen by a local or cloud AI model.

item.description: Open-source cache cleaner that moves files to the Trash instead of deleting them, using a fixed allowlist and no telemetry.

item.title: Perplexity — via awesome-mac
item.description: Search and discovery with AI.

item.title: Pages — via awesome-mac
item.description: Documents that stand apart.

item.title: Ora — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source browser with spaces, tab management, and a vertical sidebar.

item.title: Numbers — via awesome-mac
item.description: Create impressive spreadsheets.

item.title: Measure Plugin — via awesome-mac
item.description: Make it a fun to create spec for developers and teammates.

item.title: Mask This — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app that masks sensitive information in the clipboard.

item.title: Mana Security — via awesome-mac
item.description: vulnerability management app for individuals.

item.title: MagicInput — via awesome-mac
item.description: Share one keyboard and mouse between a Mac and a Windows PC by moving the pointer past the screen edge, with clipboard sync and file transfer.

item.title: MacClean — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free local Mac disk cleaner that lets you review WeChat media, System Data, and Xcode or AI caches before deleting.

item.description: Menu bar app that adds up your MRR from Stripe, RevenueCat, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments and Gumroad into one total. Multi-currency, keys stay in the Keychain, no account.

item.title: Lafz Prompter — via awesome-mac
item.description: Teleprompter that sits under the MacBook notch, can hide from screen sharing, scrolls as you speak, and shows Urdu in Nastaliq.

item.title: Keynote — via awesome-mac
item.description: Build stunning presentations.

item.title: JoeBro — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native SwiftUI workspace for chat and document editing with local models via Ollama or any API, plus memory, MCP tools, and deep research.

item.title: Daily Wallpaper — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app that sets the Bing photo of the day as your desktop and lock screen wallpaper.

item.title: AppleAi — via awesome-mac
item.description: Access multiple AI assistants from your menu bar with one shortcut.

item.title: o8 — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source desktop app that reviews coding agents' work, sends it back until it passes, and merges it.

item.title: Yado — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native Mac app for managing an iPhone: clear duplicate photos, large videos and unused apps, arrange the Home Screen, move files and keep backups on the Mac.

item.title: WellSnap — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source screenshot tool for macOS and Windows with arrows, numbered callouts, and a blur that never uses the hidden pixels.

item.description: Real-time broadcast voice rack in Swift and CoreAudio with subtle pitch depth, sub-harmonic warmth, 6-band EQ, de-esser, and compressor for Discord, Zoom, Teams, and OBS.

item.title: Quarters — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source workspace for running terminal coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Aider across many projects at once, with one-click project switching, dev-server launching and remote access from your phone.

item.title: PC Mode — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free app that brings Windows habits to your Mac: delete from Finder with the Delete key, cut and move files with ⌘X and ⌘V, and switch individual windows with ⌘Tab.

item.title: LinkUnbound — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source browser picker that asks which browser or browser profile should open each link, with rules by site or by the app the link came from.

item.title: LazyTune — via awesome-mac
item.description: Lightweight menu bar per-app audio mixer and universal media key controller for web browsers and desktop players.

item.description: Free, open-source storage analyzer for developers that explains each folder (Docker, node_modules, Xcode DerivedData, AI tool caches), marks what is safe to delete and moves everything to the Trash first.

item.title: twistel — via awesome-mac

item.title: TurboFieldfare — via awesome-mac

item.title: TocaPad — via awesome-mac
item.description: Slide your trackpad's edges to change volume and brightness, and double-tap a corner to run a shortcut.

item.title: Soju — via awesome-mac
item.description: Installs the official Windows Battle.net, Steam, Epic, GOG, EA app, Rockstar and Ubisoft Connect clients on Apple Silicon through Wine and Apple's GPTK, with a native library of all your games.

item.title: Pake — via awesome-mac
item.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with its own icon, window and Dock entry.

item.title: Noteriv — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Markdown note-taking app with wiki-links, graph view, plugins, Git/WebDAV sync and a built-in MCP server for AI assistants.

item.title: MoMo Agent — via awesome-mac

item.title: Lumela — via awesome-mac

item.title: LockPlus — via awesome-mac
item.description: WireGuard and OpenVPN client with a kill switch that macOS itself enforces.

item.title: Kombucha — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar battery charge limiter that stops charging at a chosen level to extend battery lifespan.

item.title: Cleaner — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source cleaner that shows every item before removal, keeps its rules in one public file, and holds what you remove in a 7-day quarantine you can restore from.

item.title: Browserdoor — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source link picker that asks which browser, browser profile, or Zen space should open each link.

item.title: Brk — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native Swift and AppKit rebuild of Arc on Chromium, with a Raycast-style command bar and AI that runs on your own Claude Code or Codex plan and local models.

item.title: Back to Bug — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar replay recorder that saves recent screen activity as video for bug reports.
